page.layout: One column of text, full width. Top: a heading of one line, then about three lines of text. Middle: a short group of about two lines. Lower middle: a larger heading of one line, then about three lines. Lower third: a last group of about two lines. No margin notes, running head, page number or catchword visible.
page.notes: The scan is very faint, stained and blurred. The printed lines can be seen as shapes, but I cannot read the letters with any confidence, so every line is marked illegible and the letter counts are estimates. The heading positions and the division into paragraphs are the best reading of the layout. The darker lines near the top and in the middle may be show-through from the other side of the leaf; I have not transcribed them as text. A higher-resolution or better-contrast scan would allow a proper transcription.
